doc.class_javadoc:
/**
 * A plot that displays multiple pie plots using data from a
 * {@link CategoryDataset}.
 */
public
doc.method_javadoc: /** * Creates a new plot. * * @param dataset the dataset (null permitted). */

siblings.javadoc: /** * Returns the dataset used by the plot. * * @return The dataset (possibly null). */
siblings.name: getDataset
setDataset

siblings.javadoc: /** * Returns the pie chart that is used to draw the individual pie plots. * * @return The pie chart (never null). * * @see #setPieChart(JFreeChart) */
siblings.name: getPieChart

siblings.javadoc: /** * Sets the chart that is used to draw the individual pie plots. The * chart's plot must be an instance of {@link PiePlot}. * * @param pieChart the pie chart (null not permitted). * * @see #getPieChart() */
siblings.name: setPieChart

siblings.javadoc: /** * Returns the data extract order (by row or by column). * * @return The data extract order (never null). */
siblings.name: getDataExtractOrder

siblings.javadoc: /** * Sets the data extract order (by row or by column) and sends a * {@link PlotChangeEvent} to all registered listeners. * * @param order the order (null not permitted). */
siblings.name: setDataExtractOrder

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Returns the limit (as a percentage) below which small pie sections are
     * aggregated.
     *
     * @return The limit percentage.
     */
siblings.name: getLimit

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Sets the limit below which pie sections are aggregated.
     * Set this to 0.0 if you don't want any aggregation to occur.
     *
     * @param limit  the limit percent.
     */
siblings.name: setLimit

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Returns the key for aggregated items in the pie plots, if there are any.
     * The default value is "Other".
     *
     * @return The aggregated items key.
     *
     * @since 1.0.2
     */
siblings.name: getAggregatedItemsKey

siblings.javadoc: /** * Sets the key for aggregated items in the pie plots. You must ensure * that this doesn't clash with any keys in the dataset. * * @param key the key (null not permitted). * * @since 1.0.2 */
siblings.name: setAggregatedItemsKey

siblings.javadoc: /** * Returns the paint used to draw the pie section representing the * aggregated items. The default value is Color.lightGray. * * @return The paint. * * @since 1.0.2 */
siblings.name: getAggregatedItemsPaint

siblings.javadoc: /** * Sets the paint used to draw the pie section representing the aggregated * items and sends a {@link PlotChangeEvent} to all registered listeners. * * @param paint the paint (null not permitted). * * @since 1.0.2 */
siblings.name: setAggregatedItemsPaint

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Returns a short string describing the type of plot.
     *
     * @return The plot type.
     */
siblings.name: getPlotType

siblings.javadoc: /** * Draws the plot on a Java 2D graphics device (such as the screen or a * printer). * * @param g2 the graphics device. * @param area the area within which the plot should be drawn. * @param anchor the anchor point (null permitted). * @param parentState the state from the parent plot, if there is one. * @param info collects info about the drawing. */
siblings.name: draw

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Returns a collection of legend items for the pie chart.
     *
     * @return The legend items.
     */
siblings.name: getLegendItems

siblings.javadoc: /** * Tests this plot for equality with an arbitrary object. Note that the * plot's dataset is not considered in the equality test. * * @param obj the object (null permitted). * * @return true if this plot is equal to obj, and * false otherwise. */
siblings.name: equals

sig.class_declaration: public class MultiplePiePlot extends Plot implements Cloneable, Serializable
methods: public void draw(Graphics2D g2, Rectangle2D area, Point2D anchor, PlotState parentState, PlotRenderingInfo info);
type_signatures: public interface CategoryDataset extends KeyedValues2D, Dataset {  }
